messages:
maria: Hey team — quick Q while debugging a throughput drop on canary: where's the combined cross-region GPU memory / SM% / KV cache hitrate dashboard? I remember a combo panel but can't find it. Also is the kv_cache_eviction alert noisy lately? pinging @ajay @ken

ajay: Try the GPU throughput dashboard: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/abc123/gpu-throughput?orgId=1&from=now-6h — panels named 'SM Utilization', 'GPU Memory per SM', and 'KVCache hitrate' (bottom-right). Loki for logs: https://loki.internal.redwood/ — search `kv_cache` or `evict` around the spike. Tempo trace explorer: https://traces.internal.redwood/

PromQL snippets I used:
```
avg by (pool) (irate(gpu_sm_utilization[5m])) * 100
sum by (pool) (irate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) / sum by (pool) (irate(kv_cache_requests_total[5m])) * 100
```

ajay: If you want a single-panel link, append `&viewPanel=17` to the dashboard URL (panel id 17 is kv hitrate).

ken: If kv_cache_eviction_rate is firing a lot the current rule (in infra/alerts/gpu_kv_eviction.yaml) is pretty aggressive for canaries. We set it around 0.5% over 5m during rollout; suggest bump to 1% for canary pools or add `for: 10m`. Also check the batching experiment PR — https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/432 needs review @maria

maria: Can someone drop the panel permalink here and I'll attach a trace id from the spike: 7f8d2c9a4b? Also need p95 latency for the window (30m before/after). I'll start a tiny runbook in the incident tracker.

sam: Quick check — p95 jumped ~120ms -> ~480ms coincident with kv cache miss rate climbing. My hypothesis: increased batch-size scaling caused more KV evictions under memory pressure. I recommend rolling back the batch-scaling change in canary (set max_batch_size back to 8) while we investigate.

Rollback command:
```
redwoodctl apply -f svc-configs/batching.yaml --env=canary
```

Temporary alert tweak proposal (suggested):
```
alert: KVCACHE_HIGH_EVICTION
expr: increase(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m]) / increase(kv_cache_requests_total[5m]) > 0.01
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: page
```

runtime-bot: deploy-notify: canary-batcher v3.2.1 deployed by @ci — trace: https://traces.internal.redwood/trace/7f8d2c9a4b

ken: I'll review the PR now. FYI I added a small dashboard PR that injects a direct panel shortcut and a short blurb about alerting thresholds; will push link shortly. Note: for cross-region queries include `region` label, e.g. `region=~"us-.*"` to limit to US regions.

maria: Awesome, @ken when you push the panel link can you also add a short note in the dashboard description about recommended thresholds for canary vs prod? I'll file a short postmortem if the rollback doesn't stabilize things. Thanks :thumbsup:

ajay: Single-panel link: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/abc123/gpu-throughput?viewPanel=17 — captioned 'KV cache hitrate (by pool, region)'. I also added a quick time-shift preset for canary windows. cc @product-observability

maria: Great — heading to run the p95 query now. If anyone sees a repeat spike please drop the trace id here.
